notes: Raw SSE byte stream per the documented streaming sequence: message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta with text_delta/input_json_delta/thinking_delta/signature_delta variants, content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop, ping. Wire format: one event per data line, 'event:' + 'data:' fields, LF line endings, CRLF also legal. The paired .expected.json holds the canonical ir.StreamEvent sequence this stream must decode to.
